title: Vaso-occlusive crisis in the cervicofacial region in sickle cell anemia
html: Sickle cell anemia (SCA) is an autosomal recessive disorder characterized by a point mutation in the β-globin chain of the hemoglobin protein, causing abnormal folding. This can lead to sickling of red blood cells, agglutination, and ultimately vascular obstruction, which rarely occurs in the cervicofacial region.
